text:
Priya Patel: hey people-ops — need routing guidance. hiring manager wants a one-time signing stipend for Anita Kapoor: $12,000 split across two fiscal years (6k now, 6k next FY). start target 2026-05-20. is this an exception? what approvals and payroll lead time do we need?

People Ops: @Priya Patel yup, that's an exception to standard sign-on. we'll need comp committee approval + finance sign-off and a payroll setup ticket. please include: total comp band, base, any bonus offsets, and a short business justification. for split payments we require documented reason (e.g., FY budgeting / retention across fiscal boundary).

Kelly Wu: to add — confirm comp band and manager's requested level so comp ops can evaluate uplift.

Jared Morgan: confirming band = L5 / Band 5, base $170,000, no bonus offset. manager requests 12k one-time, split 6k at offer acceptance and 6k on first payroll of next FY. justification: retention across FY boundary due to budget constraints in current FY.

People Ops: routing steps (quick):
1) Open an Offer Exception request in the People Ops approvals page: https://confluence.redwood/inflight/offer-exceptions (select "Signing stipend split").
2) Attach the candidate packet (resume, comp packet, hiring authority note).
3) Fill the justification field (copy of Jared's note ok).
4) Tag @CompOps and @Finance in the request.
5) People Ops triages then comp committee reviews. if approved, People Ops sends the payroll setup ticket to Payroll with the dates.

Priya Patel: i'm uploading the packet now: https://drive.redwood/candidates/anita-kapoor-packet (drop in the request).

CompOps Bot: New exception request created: EXC-2026-045 — status: pending comp committee review. Assigned to: comp-chair.

Payroll: note — operational details: split stipend will be processed as two separate taxable payments. Payroll needs at least 10 business days lead time before each planned payment to ensure correct tax withholding and journal coding. for deferred FY payment we prefer a firm calendar date at approval time to reserve budget coding.

People Ops: also flag on benefits: if start date is 2026-05-20, benefits eligibility rules apply per site (some locations start next month). candidate may not have full benefits until first of next month — confirm with benefits team if coverage needs to be backdated. international hires will need local withholding checks; ping @People Ops International if Anita is not US-based.

Priya Patel: timeline question — can comp committee decide by 2026-05-10? manager needs the offer by 2026-05-12 to keep the candidate in process.

Jared Morgan: flagged as high priority with manager and comp chair. i'll escalate.

People Ops: noted. i'll mark EXC-2026-045 as expedited and ask comp chair for a 48h turnaround. will update in-thread when decision arrives. :thumbsup:

Priya Patel: appreciated — i'll keep candidate timeline tight and confirm any benefit edge cases once packet is reviewed.

CompOps Bot: Update EXC-2026-045 — comp committee requested a 1-line retention rationale from manager. action: Jared Morgan to reply with retention metrics.

Jared Morgan: replied in EXC-2026-045 with: "Retention rationale: candidate has competing offer with later start and counteroffer window; split stipend ties candidate to Redwood across FY boundary; agreed manager commit to 6-month retention check-in."

People Ops: perfect. comp committee meeting tomorrow AM — pushing for approval. will post final decision and next steps (PAYROLL ticket creation) here when available.

Priya Patel: thanks team — will stand by and prep the formal offer language once approved. :pray:
